correctness.rationale: The positive-term log limit of the rational three-season integral gives H+1; local uniformity of the finite log-sums and convergence of the three updates justify evaluating it at the limiting image, including on switching lines. Independently, H≤h is equivalent to −h≤x≤h and max(−h,−h−x,x−1−h)≤y≤min(h+1,h+1+x). For x<0 the vertical span is 1+2h+2x; for x≥0 it is 1+2h−max(0,x−1). These bounds yield precisely the asserted vertices, area 3h²+2h−(max(0,h−1))²/2, and primitive perimeter 6h+2−max(0,h−1). The orientation-preserving return map preserves lattice arclength on each affine segment because its integer unimodular derivative maps primitive tangent to primitive tangent, also for restrictions along a switching line. Hence it is a translation in counterclockwise arclength. The orbit of (−h,0) after one update is (0,h), then (h,h), then (h,max(0,1−h)); the resulting displacement along the polygon is 2h+1. This proves the rotation formula and, by differentiating the two branches, the strict minimum and change of twist at h=1. In the lower rational branch the gcd of numerator and denominator is gcd(q,2); in the upper branch integer linear combinations recover p and q, so the gcd is one. This gives exact periods, including 18 at both displayed resonance levels, and irrational density. Integral vertices give one lattice point per unit of boundary arclength, and 2(5m+3)−5(2m+1)=1 proves transitivity on each positive integer shell. At h=0 only x=0, 0≤y≤1 is feasible; the return map reflects the segment and exchanges its two integer endpoints. The package's finite controls were inspected but not executed or used to infer exhaustiveness.
residual_risks: The proof is an analytic review, not formal verification. The theorem concerns the specified three-step return map, not arbitrary seasonal schedules or perturbations.

value.rationale: This nonautonomous tropical model gives a sharp example in which the geometry of a single shrinking edge changes the sign of twist and makes two distinct invariant polygons share a prescribed frequency. The same exact rotation computation classifies all rational periods, irrational dynamics, and every integer trajectory without truncating to a finite region. The arithmetical orbit partition and the explicit obstruction to monotone twist are independently useful features of this fixed map.
residual_risks: No generalization to other schedules, smooth conjugacy, or twist persistence under perturbation is supplied.
